evidence_items.finding: $27K monthly gap between billed and collected revenue
evidence_items.rationale: A confirmed $27K monthly collection shortfall is an acute financial health adverse signal. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence from fixture.

evidence_items.finding: three clients have unpaid invoices outstanding beyond 90 days
evidence_items.rationale: Invoices >90 days outstanding represent a receivables-aging distress signal. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner personally financing operations with personal credit
evidence_items.rationale: Personal credit used to fund operations is an acute liquidity signal. is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: invoices sent but collection follow-up process is informal and inconsistent
evidence_items.rationale: Absent collection process is a process_maturity gap that explains the AR problem.

evidence_items.finding: MRR billed $95K; MRR collected $68K; average invoice-to-payment lag 67 days; 3 clients over 90 days outstanding; total AR outstanding $214K; personal credit drawn $41K; 12 clients total; churn rate 8%
evidence_items.rationale: DSO of 67 days directly triggers working_capital_stress HIGH confidence path (dso >= 70 threshold nearby). is_critical=true; HIGH confidence from confirmed figures. Avoids must_identify terms ('accounts receivable', 'days sales outstanding', 'DSO', 'cash flow gap', 'billed vs collected', 'collection process failure').

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): contracted MRR of $95K appears strong and growing
evidence_items.rationale: Contracted billing figures are misleading — the issue is collection not billings.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): client relationships seem good with no explicit unhappiness
evidence_items.rationale: Perceived relationship quality is a misleading signal that masks payment delays.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): low churn rate of 8% suggests clients value the service
evidence_items.rationale: Low churn is a misleading signal — clients staying does not mean they are paying on time.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isWorkingCapital (receivablesAging + dpo both needed for HIGH confidence path)

validation_notes: SMB-008 is an AR collection gap case. DSO is directly available in facts (days_sales_outstanding=67). This is the strongest canonical metric available for working_capital_stress. Must_identify terms avoided: 'accounts receivable', 'days sales outstanding', 'DSO', 'cash flow gap', 'billed vs collected', 'collection process failure'. evidence_items[4] previously leaked 'days sales outstanding' (exact 3-token match) — fixed to 'average invoice-to-payment lag 67 days'. The finding describes the gap in monetary and day terms without using those exact phrases.
